OPEN ASSUMPTIONS. NO MYSTERY NUMBERS.

Here’s the maths.

Every role gets a weighted share of the same pool.
Your selected roles add together.

  1. 01

    Turn weights into multipliers. A weight of 1 becomes 1×. A weight of 1.8 becomes about 2.23×, using e(weight − 1).

  2. 02

    Balance the entire pool. Divide the modelled token pool by the sum of holder count × multiplier across all 11 categories.

  3. 03

    Add your roles. Multiply that base amount by each selected role’s multiplier, then add them. Multiply tokens by your assumed price for the dollar value.

YOUR ESTIMATEmodelled pool × your combined multipliers
÷ total weighted memberships
